newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EMS says to buy bearer shares at 6,000 Sfr.
newsitem.headline: EMS says to buy bearer shares at 6,000 Sfr.

text.p: EMS Chemie Holding AG said it was offering to buy back up to 40,000 of its bearer shares at a price of 6,000 Swiss francs each in an offer that expires on March 19.
"EMS-Chemie Holding AG intends to buy back its own shares to reduce its share capital," it said in a statement.
"Shareholders can offer the company a maximum of 40,000 bearer shares at a price of 6,000 francs per bearer share until March 19, 1997 at 6 p.m. (1700 GMT)," it said.
Its board would recommend to the general assembly on August 23 to reduce the company's share capital by the par value of the repurchased shares, it added.
In its latest annual report, EMS said it had 481,525 bearer shares at 50 francs par and 729,300 registered shares at 10 francs par. Bearer shares closed down five at 5,900 today.
Registered shares controlled 60.2 percent of the votes and bearer shares 39.8 percent, it said in the 1995/96 annual report.
